big_picture.title: Dow Charges Up 3% After Decisive Election Win For Democrats; Tesla, SpaceX Shares Stumble
big_picture.excerpt: Major indexes advance Wednesday after a clear win for Democrats.
paragraphs: Investors drove stocks sharply higher Wednesday, as the market overcame political uncertainty with the Democratic Party in the 2026 midterm elections winning control of the next U.S. Congress. Treasury yields and oil prices receded.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average vaulted 1,569 points higher, or 3%, to 53,356. The blue-chip index marked its largest gain in a post-midterm election session since 1982, when it rose 4.25%.
